title: Argus gateway command (v1)
description: What %noltbook-calls POSTs to the gateway, and what the gateway rebuilds and POSTs to the warden. Documents the format already in use; no version field is carried on the wire.

req.description: Caller-chosen idempotency key, unique per (subject, req). Replaying it returns the first answer with duplicate:true.

subject.description: AUTHENTICATED AUTHORITY. The ship on whose behalf the command runs. Derived by %noltbook-calls from src.bowl and inserted by it; never taken from a browser or from a request header. The room namespace is keyed by it, so it decides ownership.

participant.description: The ship an access grant or eviction is ABOUT. Deliberately distinct from subject: naming a participant grants that participant access to the subject's room, and transfers no authority to them.

ttl.description: Requested lease seconds. Lease operations only. The warden clamps it to its configured bounds; the value returned in deadline is authoritative.
